effect.name: Outline
effect.description: Draws a border around the sprite's silhouette. The single most useful effect in a 2D game: it lifts a character off a busy background, marks a selected unit, and flashes an interactable.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Alpha
parameter.description: Outline opacity. 0 turns the outline off without removing the effect.

parameter.name: Alpha Cutoff
parameter.description: How opaque a pixel has to be to count as part of the sprite. Lower it for soft-edged art.

parameter.name: 8-Way
parameter.description: On checks the diagonals too, which keeps corners from being clipped. Off is the cheaper 4-way version.

parameter.name: Inside
parameter.description: On draws the border just inside the silhouette instead of around it, so the sprite does not grow.
